pages.text: PRESENTATION 2025 to Help Shape a Better Future

ABOUT Uniting Visionaries for Conscious Evolution “The World Changers Summit (WCS) is an exclusive, by-invitation-only nonprofit initiative established by the Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation (IASC). This prestigious interdisciplinary gathering, reserved for a small, carefully selected group of leaders, innovators, and visionaries, takes place in remarkable and symbolic venues around the world. It offers participants not only intellectual engagement but also transformative emotional experiences, fostering deep connections, reflection, and a shared sense of purpose.”

Igniting Unity & Consciousness Rooted in a bold and forward-looking mission, the WCS seeks to cultivate a lasting legacy by elevating consciousness and fostering greater awareness among global leaders, scientists, visionaries, and creative minds. Through the convergence of ethics, innovation, diplomacy, governance, and sustainable development, the Summit creates a space for the co-creation of tangible, ethical solutions to humanity’s most pressing challenges. The Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation (IASC) is extending a limited and exclusive invitation to select mission-aligned partners to join the World Changers Initiative—a global, nonprofit movement uniting ethics, innovation, and leadership. This is a unique opportunity to become part of an influential network of heads of state, scientists, visionaries, and changemakers working together to shape a more conscious, cooperative, and sustainable future. Participation is by invitation only. Empower change. Elevate your legacy. Be a World Changer.

MISSION Catalyzing Evolutionary Change Elevating Human Consciousness The summit champions principled leadership that transcends individual interests, fostering a profound shift in collective awareness that elevates humanity. Dynamic Interdisciplinary Collaboration It brings together the brightest minds from diverse disciplines, forging strategic alliances to collaboratively address and solve the most pressing challenges of the time. Transformational Dialogue & Action Through meaningful discourse, it inspires transformative insights that lead directly to impactful, sustainable global solutions. Empowering Future Leaders The summit’s commitment extends beyond today’s leadership, cultivating the next generation of changemakers through mentorship, strategic partnerships, and an enriching exchange of ideas and wisdom.

An Environment Like No Other The World Changers Summit provides an unparalleled environment—where groundbreaking ideas flourish, inspired by a synergy of intellectual rigor, artistic brilliance, and emotional depth. This potent atmosphere stimulates creativity, innovation, and a vibrant energy that fuels profound personal and collective growth. Together, participants form a robust network of enlightened individuals, unified in their pursuit of excellence, responsibility, and profound global impact. Expanding into a Multimedia and Networking Platform Thanks to this unique and compelling formula, the World Changers Summit has grown significantly, attracting some of the most brilliant and unique minds from around the globe. Today, it proudly announces its expansion beyond live events. The summit is launching an innovative multimedia platform encompassing the metaverse, communication technologies, and educational resources, enabling year-round interaction, collaboration, and continuous learning among the global community. The Summit Does Not Just Envision the Future—It Shapes It At the World Changers Summit, vision becomes reality. With courage, wisdom, and unwavering commitment, the summit transcends mere aspiration and actively constructs a future that reflects humanity’s highest potential. Welcome to the World Changers Summit—where visionary leadership meets transformative action.

Sir Prof. Dr. Gabriele Pao-Pei Andreoli MD www.gpandreoli.com Sir Prof. Dr. Gabriele Pao-Pei Andreoli is a globally recognized leader, visionary thinker, and humanitarian whose career bridges medicine, diplomacy, ethical innovation, and interdisciplinary development. With a foundation rooted in science and elevated by humanistic values, he has built a legacy of uniting institutions, cultures, and visionary minds to shape a more conscious, ethical, and collaborative future. President, Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation (IASC) President, LiDu Ethical AI (Italian League for Human Rights) Liaison Representative, Pontifical Academy of Theology, Vatican City State Ambassador Representative, Red Cross of Northern Macedonia Founder & Director, World Changers Summit (WCS) gabriele.p.andreoli GabrielePaoPeiAndreoli gppandreoli gabriele-andreoli

ffiliated as a professor of diplomacy and international relations with prestigious institutions across Europe and the United States, Sir Andreoli’s extensive work encompasses regenerative medicine, artificial intelligence, sustainable agriculture, cyber security, and humanitarian diplomacy, always placing ethics and global cooperation at its core. Sir Andreoli is the author of several internationally acclaimed books and has been honored with over 20 prestigious awards and honorary titles, acknowledging his profound contributions to science, innovation, and humanitarian advancement. The founding of the World Changers Summit reflects his unwavering vision: to create a global platform where knowledge, values, and visionary leadership converge—not merely to shape the future, but to elevate it. “It wasn’t just an idea. It was a feeling—a gap between potential and reality that called to be bridged, a space where knowledge meets emotions, ethics, values meet vision, and action becomes inevitable, a quantum leap toward evolution.” In his words, Sir Andreoli recognizes that the world does not lack ideas— but often lacks the right environment and that unite those capable of creating true change. Thus, the World Changers Summit was born—not as a mere event, but as a shared vision for those who actively shape the future by mastering the present. WCS is designed for the courageous, those who regard the future as a collective responsibility. It serves as a powerful platform where science meets ethics, artificial intelligence meets humanity, and global collaboration becomes the most significant force for sustainable progress. Power comes from knowledge! “How World Changer Summit was born?”

WORLD CHANGERS SUMMIT 2023 Theme: Artificial Intelligence, Applications & Risk Management 5 July 2023 1Edition Shaping the Future with Vision, Integrity, and Innovation In an era defined by exponential technological advancement, the World Changers Summit opened its inaugural session with a commanding and timely theme: “Artificial Intelligence, Applications & Risk Management.” This topic was not chosen by chance. It reflects the Summit’s core philosophy—to elevate dialogue at the intersection of technology, ethics, and leadership, and to anticipate tomorrow’s challenges before they become today’s crises. The event addressed the growing influence of AI across industries—from customer engagement and corporate operations to compliance and policy—but it also spotlighted the emerging vulnerabilities: algorithmic bias, lack of transparency, and the potential erosion of human agency in decision-making processes. Delegates explored how intelligent systems can either serve as instruments of progress or become tools of inequity, depending on how we architect their development, governance, and oversight. With over 70 participants and 21 distinguished speakers, the discussion was not only visionary but also action-oriented—centred on the urgent need to establish a responsible AI ecosystem grounded in ethical leadership, interdisciplinary collaboration, and sustainable innovation. 1 EDITION 1 EDITION SCANHEREEVENT & VIDEODETAIL S

Artificial Intelligence: Applications & Risk Management Exploring AI’s potential across industries while addressing critical concerns like algorithmic bias, transparency, and ethical governance. Evolutionary Biohacking A transformative approach to regenerative medicine, blending science, wellness, and innovation to enhance human performance and longevity. H.I.T. (Holographic Information Transfer) Revolutionary non-invasive tech using electromagnetic signals to stimulate targeted biochemical effects for advanced medical treatment. Finance & Strategic Investment Redefining finance through ethics-driven economic models and connecting visionary investors to sustainable, cross-sector innovation. Leadership & Vision Rethinking leadership in a complex world—emphasizing purpose, ethics, and forward-thinking grounded in science and social impact. Technology & Innovation From the Metaverse to hydrogen engines and geothermal energy— technological progress as a tool for sustainability and resilience. Social Responsibility & Inclusion Promoting multicultural dialogue, gender equality, nonprofit innovation, and the power of diversity as a foundation for societal transformation. Core Themes

His Eminence Cardinal Peter Turkson Chancellor, Pontifical Academy of Sciences Cardinal Turkson opened the Summit with a message of profound moral clarity, calling for a renewed alignment between science, human values, and stewardship. His presence emphasized the Vatican’s commitment to dialogues that transcend boundaries in pursuit of the common good. FEATURED SPEAKERS Rowena Gates Principal, Eng3 Corporation Pioneering advancements in health optimization through applied technology, Rowena Gates shared insights on the fusion of data science, cellular repair, and responsible tech innovation. Prof. Lawrence M. Krauss Theoretical Physicist | Best-Selling Author | President, The Organic Projects A globally respected voice in cosmology and scientific ethics, Prof. Krauss explored the metaphysical implications of artificial intelligence and our collective responsibility to harmonize discovery with dignity. Joe Foster Founder of Reebok A legend in global entrepreneurship, Joe Foster reflected on innovation as a tool for societal uplift—sharing his journey from sportswear to social impact, and how AI is shaping the next generation of entrepreneurial legacy. Voices That Inspire. Minds That Transform. This premiere event welcomed an extraordinary lineup of thought leaders, innovators, and legacy-makers— each contributing unique insights from diverse fields including science, entrepreneurship, philosophy, and diplomacy. Venue: Pontifical Academy of Sciences & Vatican Museums A Sanctuary of Wisdom, Beauty, and Global Purpose There are venues—and then there are sanctuaries of history, spirit, and human brilliance. The inaugural World Changers Summit unfolded within the awe-inspiring walls of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences, one of the Vatican’s most sacred and intellectually profound institutions. With a legacy that spans centuries of scientific and ethical exploration, the Academy provided not just a location, but a symbolic foundation—where reason meets reverence, and progress is guided by principle.

But the experience did not end there. In an unprecedented gesture of exclusivity, the Vatican Museums opened their gates after hours, with doors closed to the public, welcoming the Summit’s select participants—visionaries, changemakers, and leaders from around the globe—for an intimate, curated tour through the heart of one of the world’s greatest artistic and cultural treasures. Under the ethereal silence of the Sistine Chapel and the golden halls of Renaissance genius, guests walked through centuries of beauty and truth—reflecting on humanity’s past, while shaping its future. The evening culminated with a refined cocktail reception in the Giardini dei Musei Vaticani—the private gardens of the Vatican Museums—where conversation, collaboration, and consciousness flowed beneath Roman skies, surrounded by classical sculpture and the fragrance of spring. It was more than a networking event; it was a once-in-a-lifetime communion of ideas and intentions in one of the most spiritually charged settings on earth. This was not simply a venue. This was a rite of passage—a gathering of enlightened minds in the most timeless of spaces, united by a common mission: to elevate humanity.

Legacy and Momentum The debut of the World Changers Summit marked more than an event—it signaled the birth of a movement. A movement where dialogue is elevated to vision, vision is translated into action, and action is guided by consciousness. AI, in this first act, became the perfect symbol: a mirror to our progress, and a challenge to our integrity. This is just the beginning.

WORLD CHANGERS POWER WOMEN’S SUMMIT 2023 Theme: Leadership, Legacy, Innovation & Unity Empowering Change Where Values Meet Vision 13 October 2023 2Edition On October 13, 2023, within the historic chambers of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences and the majestic surroundings of the Palazzo della Cancelleria, the second edition of the World Changers Power Women’s Summit took place—an extraordinary event that brought together 70 distinguished participants and 21 speakers from around the globe to celebrate and empower the leadership roles of women in the modern world. This summit was more than just an event. It was a manifesto of integrity, transformation, and unity, meticulously curated by the Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation (IASC). In a format that seamlessly blends the power of speech with the solemnity of the location, the summit placed the female figure at the center as a bearer of values and change. It became a platform for ideas that challenge, inspire, and build intercultural bridges. 2 EDITION 2 EDITION SCANHEREEVENT & VIDEODETAIL S

Leadership Leadership as service, grounded in humility, echoing Pope Francis: “Leadership is service; there is no leadership without service.” Focused on women building ethical, inclusive communities with moral responsibility. Legacy Legacy is defined by lasting ethical and spiritual impact, not just material achievements. The greatest legacy is living with integrity for the common good. Innovation Innovation must be measured by ethics, not just efficiency. Inspired by Pope Francis’s guidance to “walk in the light of the Lord,” the focus was on innovation that upholds human dignity. Unity Unity is strength in diversity. Through stories and intercultural experiences, the summit embraced Pope Francis’s words: “Unity does not imply uniformity... but harmony in diversity.” This edition also expanded the initiative We All Matter, welcoming voices from around the world through virtual submissions, because impact knows no borders, and dialogue knows no hierarchy. In an era where polarization dominates the global narrative, this summit offered a rare space for listening, healing, and collective reimagining. Core Themes

Robert Edward Grant Polymath & TV Host In his talk, “The Geometry of Unity: Harmonizing Leadership with Universal Laws,” Grant draws from mathematics, history, and metaphysics to explore how women’s leadership can shape a more interconnected and just world. PIONEERS OF PROGRESS Prof. Maria Amata Garito President & Rector, UNINETTUNO University A global pioneer in digital education, Garito will explore “Knowledge Without Borders: Building a Global Ethos Through Accessible Learning.” Jessica Word CEO, Word & Brown General Agency With her signature authenticity, Word comes to the summit with “Beyond the Boardroom: Leading with Clarity, Care, and Courage,” revealing the human side of high-impact leadership. Christina Rahm Clinical Psychologist & Founder, Cure the Causes Movement Blending clinical science with holistic health, Rahm presents “Bio-Spiritual Empowerment: Healing the Female Blueprint”—a powerful vision of wellness as both resistance and rebirth. Voices That Inspire. Stories That Lead. The 2024 edition presents a stellar roster of minds and hearts committed to building a better world. These are more than professionals—they are movement-makers, ethical leaders, and architects of a compassionate future. SCANHEREFULLSPEAKERSLIS T

Venue: Palazzo della Cancelleria, Pontifical Academy of Sciences & Vatican Museums A Symphony of Spirit, Culture, and Connection The World Changers Power Women’s Summit 2023 was not simply hosted—it was orchestrated across a trilogy of extraordinary spaces in Vatican City, each designed to awaken reflection, ignite connection, and elevate purpose.

The summit itself unfolded the following day in the revered chambers of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences—a sacred institution where science meets conscience, and where ethical inquiry is not just encouraged, but expected. Here, surrounded by centuries of thought leadership, the Power Women’s Summit explored themes of leadership, legacy, innovation, and unity, with every word resonating in a space designed for global stewardship. Before the first keynote took the stage, guests were invited to draw inspiration from silence. As dawn broke over Vatican City, participants entered the Vatican Museums for a private, before-hours visit, tracing the brushstrokes of Michelangelo, the genius

of Raphael, and the soul of centuries past. In the hushed majesty of the Sistine Chapel—closed to the public and open only to the summit’s guests—reflection became reverence. Following this immersive encounter with human creativity and divine vision, a private breakfast in the Giardini dei Musei Vaticani offered space for quiet dialogue and inspiration. Nestled among marble sculptures and ancient flora, conversations emerged as naturally as the Roman morning light—deep, deliberate, and full of purpose. More than mere locations, these venues became living metaphors for the summit’s mission. They reminded us that true change is cultivated not only in grand ideas, but in shared experience, sacred silence, and the courage to connect across borders. The event successfully embodied the vision of connecting values to vision, creating an environment where ideas not only thrived but were put into action for a better future.

WORLD CHANGERS SUMMIT DUBAI 2024 Theme: Redefining Tech Horizons: Navigating Sustainable Frontiers of Innovation and Culture 19 May 2024 Edition In an era where the balance between human values and technological progress feels increasingly delicate, the World Changers Summit Dubai 2024 emerged as a vital space for reflection, collaboration, and transformation. Held on May 19, 2024, in the visionary city of Dubai, the summit brought together changemakers from around the world— leaders in technology, policy, science, and culture—united by a shared commitment to responsible innovation and global wellbeing. Organized in partnership with AIMS Dubai and the London Intercultural Center, the summit stood as a powerful expression of international cooperation. In the face of complex global challenges—climate shifts, AI governance, healthcare equity, and economic disruption—this gathering did more than start conversations. It shaped a new vocabulary for change: one rooted in ethics, human dignity, and cross-sector collaboration. More than an event, the summit was a declaration of values: that progress must be inclusive, innovation must be responsible, and leadership must be visionary. 3 EDITION 3 EDITION In partnership with: AIMS Dubai & London Intercultural Center SCANHEREEVENT & VIDEODETAIL S

Ethical Innovation & Human-Centered AI Exploring the design and application of artificial intelligence, automation, and data systems that respect human dignity, privacy, and social equity. Conversations emphasized the urgent need for AI governance frameworks grounded in ethics and transparency. Sustainability-Driven Business Models Reimagining entrepreneurship and corporate responsibility through the lens of environmental and social impact. Leaders shared strategies to align profitability with purpose, focusing on regenerative economies and circular systems. Regenerative Healthcare & Bio-Technology Unpacking the transformative power of preventive medicine, biohacking, and stem cell innovation. The summit highlighted medical advancements that promote longevity, personalized care, and equitable access to health solutions. Redefining Tech Horizons: Navigating Sustainable Frontiers of Innovation and Culture The 2024 Dubai edition of the World Changers Summit focused on redefining the relationship between innovation and humanity. This year’s theme invited participants to examine how emerging technologies can serve as tools for inclusive, ethical, and sustainable progress. Key thematic pillars included: Legal and Regulatory Foresight Addressing the necessity for evolving legal systems and policy frameworks that can keep pace with technological disruption. Discussions stressed proactive governance and international collaboration to ensure justice and digital rights protection. Intercultural Dialogue & Inclusive Globalization Advocating for the preservation of cultural identity within global innovation. Speakers emphasized the importance of intercultural understanding and inclusive leadership as the foundation of long-term, people-centered progress. Education for the Future of Work Focusing on cognitive technologies, digital literacy, and skills development to prepare future generations for the rapidly evolving job market. Experts shared models for education that cultivate adaptability, ethics, and innovation. Key Focus

Prof. Dr. Ahkil Triphati Medical Researcher Prof. Triphati presented a visionary outlook on the integration of advanced technology in modern medicine. From life-saving AI to breakthroughs in diagnostics and treatment, he highlighted how the future of healthcare lies at the intersection of compassion and innovation. CATALYSTS OF CHANGE Clayton Thomas Founder & CEO, Root Brand Mr. Thomas delivered a compelling keynote on the role of business in environmental stewardship. By aligning corporate strategy with planetary health, he advocated for a future where commerce and sustainability are not at odds—but in harmony. H.H. Sheikh Humaid bin Khalid Al Qasimi Director, Khalid bin Mohammed Law Firm With clarity and foresight, Sheikh Humaid explored how legal systems must evolve to meet the ethical and structural demands of exponential technological change. His remarks called for proactive legal frameworks that protect rights while empowering innovation. H.H. Engr. Sheikh Salem bin Sultan Al Qasimi Chairman, Ras Al Khaimah International Airport A leading voice in global infrastructure development, Sheikh Salem underscored the importance of connectivity—not just in transit, but in values and vision. His address emphasized how strategic infrastructure can catalyze sustainable economic growth and foster international cooperation. Where Insight Meets Influence: Leaders Who Redefine Possibility SCANHEREFULLSPEAKERSLIS T

The Spirit of Dubai: A Living Lab for Global Futures With its breathtaking skyline, rich heritage, and bold embrace of innovation, Dubai offered a compelling backdrop to the World Changers Summit. Positioned at the crossroads of cultures, economies, and ideas, the city reflects the very essence of what the summit stands for: collaborative progress across borders.

A Legacy in Motion More than just a location, Dubai symbolized the fusion of tradition and transformation. Its role as a global hub for technology, trade, and sustainable development aligned seamlessly with the summit’s mission—making it the ideal host for dialogue that transcended sectors and geographies. Here, against the rhythm of one of the world’s most future-forward cities, participants gathered not just to share ideas—but to shape them into impact. The World Changers Summit Dubai 2024 reaffirmed that global change is not born from competition—but from collaboration with conscience. It reminded us that technology without ethics is empty, and that leadership without purpose is unsustainable. As the conversations and connections made in Dubai continue to ripple outward, they carry with them a message: That real transformation begins when innovation is guided by empathy, grounded in ethics, and shared across borders.

As we look ahead, we now turn to the next chapter—World Changers Summit Rome – Vatican City, 29 May 2024—where dialogue will continue and vision will deepen. Let this be the legacy of Dubai: a beacon of hope, a catalyst for action, and a milestone in our shared journey toward a more human future.

WORLD CHANGERS SUMMIT 2024 Theme: Wisdom, Innovation & Sacred Responsibility 29 May 2024 4Edition 4 EDITION 4 EDITION Shaping Humanity’s Future Through Ethics, Technology, and Inspired Leadership On May 2024, within the sacred halls of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences in Vatican City, the World Changers Summit returned for its fourth transformative edition—a space where science meets conscience, and innovation is guided by ethical clarity. Curated by the Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation (IASC), this annual gathering united visionary leaders, spiritual figures, and pioneering minds from across the globe to confront one shared question: What kind of future are we shaping—and for whomThe World Changer Summit On October 2024, within the sacred halls of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences in Vatican City, the World Changers Summit returned for its fourth transformative edition—a space where science meets conscience, and innovation is guided by ethical clarity. Curated by the Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation (IASC), this annual gathering united visionary leaders, spiritual figures, and pioneering minds from across the globe to confront one shared question: What kind of future are we shaping—and for whom? The World Changer Summit centered around three interconnected sectors—Artificial Intelligence, Leadership, and Technology—each explored through the lens of sacred responsibility. From AI’s promise and risks, to visionary leadership in social and environmental realms, to the breakthroughs shaping tomorrow’s technology, the summit offered both challenge and inspiration. This summit hosted 30 distinguished speakers in an intimate and limited space, with only 70 invited guests, was a call to conscience—a living dialogue where tradition meets tomorrow and innovation honors human dignity. True progress is not measured by technological advancements alone, but by our ability to live in solidarity, with justice and respect for all creation.” — Pope Francis Artificial Intelligence Exploring AI’s power and pitfalls—its impact on industries, ethics, and the urgent need for transparent, responsible governance. Technology & Innovation Highlighting breakthroughs like the Metaverse, hydrogen engines, and food tech—advancing with integrity, not just speed. Core Themes

His Eminence Cardinal Pietro Parolin Secretary of State, Holy See In his powerful keynote, Cardinal Parolin spoke to the moral and spiritual foundations of human progress, reminding participants that technology without ethics is directionless. He urged leaders to integrate compassion into innovation, and to place human dignity at the center of advancement. MINDS THAT TRANSFORM Dario Spera Founder of HIT Technology & Regenesis Dario introduced Holographic Information Transfer (HIT), a cutting-edge advancement redefining bio-communication at the cellular level. His presentation challenged current medical paradigms and offered a glimpse into a future where resonance and regeneration become central to healing. Dr. Todd Ovokaitys Innovator in Stem Cell & Vibrational Medicine With decades of experience at the forefront of integrative medicine, Dr. Ovokaitys presented the future of regenerative healthcare—showcasing vibrational biology, stem cell research, and frequency-based healing systems that blend hard science with holistic insight. Her Royal Majesty Queen Diambi Kabatusuila Traditional Queen of the Bantu People of the Congo Queen Diambi brought ancestral wisdom and indigenous perspectives to the global table, calling for respect toward nature, cultural restoration, and spiritual unity. Her message offered a vital balance to technological conversations, rooted in the intelligence of tradition. Voices That Lead with Vision and Purpose SCANHEREFULLSPEAKERSLIS T

Venue: Pontifical Academy of Sciences, Vatican City Where Sacred History Meets the Future of Humanity The summit was hosted within the hallowed grounds of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences, a place where the world’s most pressing questions have echoed for centuries. From Galileo to Einstein, this venue has long been a home for intellectual courage—and in 2024, it once again became a beacon of global collaboration.

Legacy in Motion Beyond the Summit: A Movement Rooted in Responsibility The atmosphere of the summit was elevated further through an elegant private luncheon, served within the Academy’s historic interior. Beneath Renaissance ceilings and surrounded by intellectual legacy, guests shared not only meals but missions—sparking dialogue that carried from the dining tables into the future. Here, within marble corridors and sunlit courtyards, the World Changers Summit reminded every participant that real transformation begins with real connection—between science and soul, innovation and integrity, self and society.

The World Changers Summit 2024 was never meant to be just an event—it was designed as a living dialogue, a seed of transformation planted in the sacred soil of human conscience. In the shadow of Renaissance thinkers and within the storied walls of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences, something timeless was reignited: the responsibility to shape not only what the future can be, but what it should be. Every keynote, every conversation, every shared silence in the corridors carried one unifying message—progress is meaningless without purpose. As leaders explored the frontiers of artificial intelligence, biotechnology, and planetary innovation, the summit served as a compass—orienting visionaries not toward profit or power, but toward justice, harmony, and the collective good.

WORLD CHANGERS BALKAN SUMMIT 2024 12-13 October 2024 Edition   5 EDITION 5 EDITION Theme: Empowering Progress through Ethics, Innovation, and Unity In a rapidly transforming global landscape, where ethics and innovation must walk hand in hand, the inaugural World Changers Balkan Summit (WCBS) convened in Skopje, North Macedonia, on October 12–13, 2024. Organized by the Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation (IASC), under the auspices of the Republic of North Macedonia, the event drew support from the Office of the Deputy Prime Minister, the Minister of Health, and the Minister of Environment, in collaboration with the London Intercultural Center. With the central theme “Harmony in Progress: Mastering the Present for a Thriving Future”, the summit united over 500 participants and featured 33 distinguished speakers—leaders, thinkers, and changemakers—who came together to tackle urgent regional and global challenges through ethical, technological, and strategic collaboration. Advances in Regenerative Medicine Exploring breakthroughs in stem cell therapy, tissue engineering, and personalized treatment approaches transitioning from lab research to clinical application. Cybersecurity in the Age of Quantum Computing Assessing the quantum shift in data security and strategies for post-quantum cryptography and resilience in critical infrastructure. Circular Economy: Redefining Growth and Sustainability Promoting closed-loop economic models, waste reduction, and resource efficiency to drive environmentally responsible development. Prof. Dr. Adolfo Panfili International Policy Advisor & Strategic Diplomat Prof. Dr. Adolfo Panfili, a medical doctor and surgeon, holds degrees in Psychology, Sociology, and Chiropractic. Initiated by his mentor, double Nobel laureate Prof. Linus Pauling, he has expanded the scope of orthomolecular sciences by integrating it with other disciplines, such as the use of ADSC and stem cells, Stromal Vascular Fraction (SVF), in regenerative medicine. He was the first surgeon in Italy to perform minimally invasive robotic orthopedic surgery using the Mazor system. SHAPERS OF TOMORROW’S WORLD Prof. Dr. Nikola Jankulovski Chancellor, Saints Cyril and Methodius University Prof. Dr. Nikola Jankulovski is a renowned expert in abdominal surgery and a respected leader in academia and healthcare. He has served as Rector of Ss. Cyril and Methodius University in Skopje, Director of the University Clinic for Digestive Surgery, and Dean of the Faculty of Medicine. With over 155 published scientific papers, two authored manuals, and participation in multiple research projects, his contributions to medicine and education are widely recognized. His work has earned numerous honors, including Lifetime Achievement Award, and international distinctions such as the Austrian Decoration for Science and Art and the Knight of the National Order of Merit of France. Ahmet Bagci Deputy Minister The Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry The Republic of Türkiye Ahmet Bagci Deputy Minister The Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry The Republic of Türkiye Mr. Bagci began his professional career as an expert at the Ministry of Culture and Tourism and the Ministry of Finance. Over the years, he assumed various key roles at the Court of Accounts, the Ministry of Youth and Sports, and the General Secretariat of the Presidency. In 2022, Mr. Bagci took on the role of Brussels Counselor for the European Union, and on June 22, 2023, he was appointed Deputy Minister of Agriculture and Forestry by Presidential Decree. Caitlin Sarian Cybersecurity Expert Caitlin Sarian, is a cybersecurity, data protection, and data privacy expert with 10+ years of global experience in the field. After leading TikTok’s Global Cybersecurity Advocacy team, she shifted her focus entirely to building her platform (@CybersecurityGirl), where she educates the public on online safety, demystifies cybersecurity careers, and encourages more women to pursue STEM. She is a leading cybersecurity influencer with over 1.3 million followers. Caitlin has led global cybersecurity assessments, collaborated with industry leaders like CISA Director Jen Easterly, and earned several prestigious awards, including Cybersecurity Woman of the Year-Influencer 2024. This flagship event brought together an extraordinary lineup of visionary leaders, each contributing valuable perspectives from various fields, including technology, health, and innovation. Venue: Philharmonic Hall, Skopje, North Macedonia A Fusion of History, Culture, and Innovation The World Changers Balkan Summit 2024 unfolded in the prestigious Philharmonic Hall in Skopje, a venue that exudes both cultural significance and architectural grandeur. On October 12th, the evening commenced with an elegant cocktail reception, where global thought leaders and changemakers gathered in the heart of the city to reflect on their shared mission for a brighter future.

Project Transcend, the AI research project Debuted with a 3D holographic responsive avatar of Saint Mother Teresa. This marked the first digital holographic representation of S. Mother Teresa, who was born in Skopje and is recognized for her work in promoting peace, love, and humanity. During the event, she delivered a message on religion being a uniting force. The presentation included a classical performance by world renown violinist Maestro Olen Cesari. The project not only honored her legacy but also connected generations across time and space, merging timeless human values with cutting-edge ethical technology. The digital presence of

Mother Teresa served as a profound reminder of the power of compassion in shaping a better world. In the heart of this cultural and historical setting, the evening beautifully blended the timeless with the future, creating an unforgettable experience that embodied the spirit of innovation and human connection. “Not all of us can do great things. But we can do small things with great love.” — Mother Teresa

WORLD CHANGERS ETHICAL & INNOVATION SUMMIT Theme: Social Responsibility: Cultivating Practices for Enhanced Welfare and Justice 25-26 November 2024 Edition 6 EDITION 6 EDITION Ethics in Action: Shaping a Flourishing Future Through Vision, Responsibility, and Unity In a time when humanity stands at the crossroads of unparalleled technological potential and growing global disparity, the World Changers Summit 5 was not just a gathering—but a statement of purpose. Under the patronage of the Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation (IASC) and in the heart of Vatican City, this milestone event convened 150 global participants and 31 distinguished speakers to explore the deepest questions of our era: What does it mean to innovate ethically? How do we ensure that progress uplifts, rather than divides? With its central theme—“Social Responsibility: Cultivating Practices for Enhanced Welfare and Justice”—the summit became a platform for translating ethics into practice across sectors, aiming to realign innovation with human dignity, environmental sustainability, and shared prosperity. SCANHEREEVENT & VIDEODETAIL S

Ethical Finance & Regenerative Investment Rethinking capital as a tool for integrity and impact. From DeFi to transparent fiscal systems, this theme explored financial innovation as a mechanism for inclusion and trust-building across borders. Regenerative Medicine & Human Flourishing Beyond cure: embracing compassionate, science-driven healthcare that enhances longevity while honoring individual well-being and collective access. Social Responsibility & Systemic Justice Addressing inequality not as a consequence but as a challenge to be solved—with policies and practices rooted in solidarity, equity, and inclusion. Environmental Flourishing & Interconnected Solutions Reimagining our relationship with the planet by promoting biodiversity, sustainable agriculture, and ecological intelligence as foundations for future resilience. Focus Where Purpose Meets Action

Pamela S. Evette Lieutenant Governor of South Carolina A bold advocate for ethical governance and community-centric innovation, Lt. Gov. Evette shared insights on how policy can be reoriented toward people, progress, and purpose.
